resources.string: Start a full calibration & analysis workflow
Capture RAW DNG photos and save to gallery
View, continue, export or delete past experiments
Capture R/G/B positioning frames to map sensor pixels to wavelengths.
RGB light source in front of the phone
Correct camera R/G/B channel sensitivity using a characterized source.
White light source in front of the phone
Capture blank and sample frames to measure fluorescence integrated area.
Build a concentration–fluorescence regression curve with standard groups.
Import a custom SPD CSV (wavelength_nm, intensity) or use the bundled true_spd.csv.
Drag the boundary to adjust the covered area:
Single: one blank for all steps. Full: separate blank per standard group.
Block downstream steps when G validation error exceeds 10 nm.
This app works with dedicated hardware to measure fluorescence concentration and assess mold risk in your samples.
Assemble the hardware as shown and place the phone on top of it.
Insert the calibration kit into the sample port with the wavelength-calibration section (RGB source) facing the phone. Then capture 1–5 images.
Insert the calibration kit into the sample port with the source-calibration section (white light) facing the phone. Then capture 1–5 images.
Insert your sample or blank into the sample port and capture 1–5 images.
To build the standard curve, insert each standard and its blank into the sample port and enter the corresponding concentration.
Use Capture to shoot 1–5 RAW frames, or import from Gallery / Files (DNG). Keep phone, slit, grating, ISO and focus unchanged between frames. Tap the × on a thumbnail to delete it.

The report collects every computed result: Page 1 wavelength mapping and G validation, Page 2 spectral response and fused curve, Page 3 blank-corrected sample area, Page 4 concentration regression. Values refresh automatically after each batch.
Review the regression formula, R² and predicted concentration. Finish saves the project to History; low R² or negative predictions warn that the curve is unreliable.
Standalone RAW camera: each tap saves a DNG into Pictures/FungalSentinel in your gallery. Use it to collect evidence frames outside a project.
Projects: tap an in-progress project to continue where you left off. Preset tabs: view, rename, edit or delete saved calibrations. Export produces a ZIP archive.
Configure language, positioning wavelengths, SPD source, half-screen cover, blank mode and calibration protection. Changes apply to new calculations immediately.
Adjust capture parameters: exposure 10–3000 ms, ISO 50–1600, focus 0–5 D (0 = infinity) and white balance. Keep them fixed during one experiment.
Cover the front light sensor to test the trigger; drag the slider below to move the boundary.
